acceptance_checks: .shiki/schemas/goal.schema.json completion_conditions.items is a oneOf accepting either a non-empty string or an object with required text and optional verification, and every pre-existing .shiki/goals/*.json still validates unchanged.

.shiki/schemas/report.schema.json declares an optional conditions array whose items require condition, status, and judged_by, with a status enum byte-identical to cca-verdict.schema.json acceptance[].status.
report["conditions"] is written as a sibling of report["scorecard"] and is never nested inside it.
cmd_goal_complete appends a blocking reason naming the condition for every fail verdict, and does NOT block on insufficient_evidence.
A goal whose tasks are all done but which carries a failing glob_count condition produces report status blocked, a non-empty blocking_reasons, and exit code 1.
A goal whose tasks are all done and whose conditions all pass produces report status complete and exit code 0.
A prose-only condition yields status insufficient_evidence with judged_by goal_cca and does not block at this task's gate.
tests/test_goal_conditions.py covers each verification kind plus the fail-blocks and pass-completes paths.
non_goals: Gating on insufficient_evidence; that flip belongs to the goal CCA task.
Any change to scripts/shiki_loop.py or the loop decision engine.
Migrating or rewriting any existing .shiki/goals record.
scope: Add scripts/shiki_goal_conditions.py exposing evaluate_conditions(target, goal, tasks) with verification kinds path_exists, glob_count, http, and command. Make cmd_goal_complete write report["conditions"] as a sibling of scorecard and extend its blocking set with every fail verdict. Widen .shiki/schemas/goal.schema.json completion_conditions.items to oneOf[string, object], and declare the optional conditions array in .shiki/schemas/report.schema.json.
test_command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && python3 scripts/validate_shiki.py --target . && for s in scripts/test_shiki_*.sh; do bash "$s" || exit 1; done
title: Record a per-condition verdict in the goal completion report and block completion on a failing condition
